definitions.explanation: A general term for any textile or material spread on the floor for comfort, decoration, or protection. Includes rugs, carpets, mats, and similar coverings.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{新|あたら}しい{敷物|しきもの}を{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a new mat at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ペルシャ{製|せい}の{敷物|しきもの}は{高級品|こうきゅうひん}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Persian rugs are known as luxury items.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {敷|し}く (to spread, to lay) + {物|もの} (thing). A broad term covering rugs, carpets, mats, and other floor coverings. In Japanese homes, this can include {畳|たたみ} mats as well as Western-style carpets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敷物|しきもの}を{敷|し}く (to lay a rug)
- {敷物|しきもの}を{替|か}える (to change the floor covering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カーペット: carpet — specifically a Western-style wall-to-wall or area carpet
- ラグ: rug — a smaller decorative floor covering
- マット: mat — a smaller, often functional floor covering
